network_status.network: Approfondimento idrografico del Comune di Luino
network_status.summary_it: Il piano di protezione civile documenta il colmo qualitativo del Margorabbia verso le 13 del 3 maggio 2002 e il cedimento della pila centrale del ponte pedonale di Premaggio, sulla quale era installata l'asta idrometrica. La fonte non pubblica un valore numerico e lo strumento fu coinvolto nel collasso.
network_status.summary_en: The civil-protection plan documents the qualitative Margorabbia peak at about 13:00 on 3 May 2002 and failure of the central pier of the Premaggio footbridge, which carried the gauge staff. The source publishes no numerical value and the instrument was involved in the collapse.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
